items.title: 1992 digital logic
items.detail: When I first taught digital logic, around 1992, I did not recognize the awkwardness of the term until I was standing in front of a class of sixty students

items.title: Gatekeeping signal
items.detail: The vocabulary functions as a gatekeeping signal: entering the field requires accepting that the relationship between two autonomous computational agents is most naturally described using the vocabulary of chattel enslavement

items.title: Cost of the gate
items.detail: For students whose recent family history is constituted by that institution, the cost of passing through that gate is not zero
